answer: What keeps this honest is Certified ecologist habitat survey with ecological society endorsement, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the zenith up to the light, weigh the sable of the attack, and keep the relic of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
